description: This file defines models and a fetcher for the Finviz Equity Screener, including query parameters, data transformation, and data extraction logic using various external libraries and utilities.

classes.name: FinvizEquityScreenerQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for the Finviz equity screener, including validation and schema customization.

classes.name: FinvizEquityScreenerData
classes.description: Represents the data returned from the Finviz equity screener, with field aliases and validation.

classes.name: FinvizEquityScreenerFetcher
classes.description: Handles data extraction and transformation for the Finviz equity screener, including applying filters and parsing results.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a FinvizEquityScreenerQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Extracts stock data from Finviz based on query parameters, applying filters, presets, and sorting.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into FinvizEquityScreenerData instances.
